name: SimpleArduinoTimer
description: A Simple Timer Library for Arduino that is non blocking. This means you can set multiple timers, or execute NON-BLOCKING Code. (USE millis() instead of delay()). Optionally supports RTC (DS3231) via #define useRTCModule.
Notes: RTClib (DS3231) support is optional. Add #define useRTCModule before including SimpleArduinoTimer.h and install RTClib to enable RTC functionality.
